scope: complete frozen x86_64 Linux configuration; separate disposable KVM cold boots
original_slot_semantics: O2 is the native registry slot for the original per-TU backend recipe, including actual O2/Os mixtures; it is not uniform -O2
hia_variants: three independently imported and qualified complete builds with distinct build_root and program_root; generated HIA bundle identity is not assumed equal
run_id_rule: first 24 hex characters of SHA256 canonical [campaign_id,partition,block,phase,arm-or-image,seed]
arm_order_rule: sort all eight arms by SHA256 canonical [randomization_seed,block,phase,arm], with lexical tie break
phase_order: the four registered phases once in each block; controllers receive only the current phase, never a future phase list or future observations

prediction.unit: one independent boot statistic = median of five measured guest samples
prediction.feedback: same complete ended history for all adaptive arms; no partial episode, qualification, or future outcome is a model input
prediction.aggregation: exact rational median of training plus completed heldout boot medians; retain latest nine

transition_model.prior: one Laplace pseudocount for each ordered pair of phases
transition_model.training: within each actual calibration all-boot phase sequence
transition_model.history: one transition between successive completed decision phases; not one per arm or within-boot repeat
transition_model.forecast: current phase is stage zero; later distributions are exact rational Markov propagation from past counts

objective.latency: Q32 ties-even of 100 * stock same-phase training median ns / predicted or observed boot median ns
objective.image_size: Q32 ties-even of 100 * stock bzImage bytes / selected bzImage bytes; not runtime RAM
objective.switch_cost_reason: every image is already a separate cold boot; no artificial action-coupling reward or penalty
objective.risk_meaning: unmodeled, not a calibrated safety probability
objective.candidate_inventory: all 3^4=81 complete paths plus literal abstain; no score-based pruning
objective.tie_policy: only an image common to the entire optimal frontier is selected; otherwise abstain
objective.abstain: execute the incumbent hia-original for the full mandatory workload and charge all actual costs
objective.ordinary_mpc: hold current public target over the entire horizon
objective.same_objective: independent Rust signed ties-even preference solve, every term/value/feasibility/frontier; its own previous weights, no native response input; independent Python audits all results
objective.ndu: invoke pinned production Rust kernel adapter; dynamic uses actual next_request_state lineage; fixed uses actual native fixed mode
objective.best_fixed: choose one image before holdout by mean of four phase-specific public-target training utilities; ties use hia-original, hia-o3, hia-os order
objective.resource_cost: sum of four stage Q32 predictions: each exact past-only phase distribution weights the actual calibration/history boot-median duration_ns, converted to microseconds with ties-even
objective.resource_budget: the same model's complete four-stage incumbent hia-original path cost; all 81 paths are submitted before feasibility filtering
objective.resource_meaning: predicted execution-time budget coupling the four stages; neither a measured deadline guarantee nor a risk probability
objective.greedy: choose greatest instantaneous utility only among first images with at least one feasible complete suffix under the identical four-stage prediction budget

statistics.independent_cluster: one of five boot blocks containing all four phase cells and all eight arms
statistics.bootstrap: exhaustive paired nonparametric block bootstrap: 5^5=3125 resamples
statistics.confidence_interval: percentile 2.5 and 97.5 percent, exact rational interpolation

record: actual parallel build window and child command CPU
costs.static_setup: only that arm's necessary image build and qualification; no three-image search, calibration, or native adapter fees
costs.feedback: report delivery cost and supplied-feedback condition separately from the fully charged shared-feedback scenario
costs.deployment_unit: one four-phase cycle containing four cold boots
costs.break_even: computed only from registered measured setup and cycle costs; report unreachable when per-cycle savings are nonpositive; extrapolation is conditional, not an online deployment claim

admission.failed_or_interrupted_run: retain and stop the entire campaign; no rerun, seed redraw, outlier filtering, or fabricated PASS
admission.trust_boundary: source and hash closure detects changes and reuse; files alone are not cryptographic proof against an operator fabricating all evidence

claims.same_actions: if same-objective and dynamic-NDU actions coincide, report mechanism equivalence on this experiment and compare implementation overhead
claims.cold_boot_limit: this does not measure seamless online kernel replacement or livepatch
